title: Microsoft Purview: unified Classifiers page for sensitive information types and trainable classifiers
summary: The briefing passes: its navigation paths, PowerShell calls and access requirements are supported by Microsoft documentation. It accurately distinguishes the preview documentation and Message Center rollout schedule from the later roadmap target, and identifies the remaining default-state and licensing gaps.
